name: commit_and_push
description: Commit every change in the worktree with the given message and push the branch. Use a Conventional Commit message (feat(scope): ..., fix: ...). Make small, focused commits: call it after each coherent piece of work. With several repositories in the workspace, say which with `repo`. In a scratch project it only commits, locally: nothing is pushed.

repo.description: The slot to commit and push: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.
